name: FileUpload
description: Drag-and-drop file picker with a removable file list and per-file progress bars.
designIntent: File inputs are hard to style and easy to make inaccessible. FileUpload keeps the native input as the real control, adds a drop zone as an enhancement, and exposes plain File objects so the transport and progress stay yours.

props.name: label
props.defaultValue: Drop files here or click to browse

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper line under the drop zone.

props.name: progress
props.description: Per-file progress 0-100 keyed by file name; renders progress bars.

props.name: selectedFilesLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the selected-files list.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for a file remove button.

props.name: uploadingLabel
props.description: Accessible label for a file upload progress bar.

antiPatterns.title: Don't hide the input from the a11y tree
antiPatterns.explanation: The label targets the real input, keeping keyboard and mobile file dialogs working.
antiPatterns.example:
// Avoid: tabIndex={-1} display:none input
// Prefer: <FileUpload /> (input is sr-only but focusable)

accessibility.implementation: Visible label targets a real (sr-only) file input
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide aria-label or wrap in FormField

accessibility.implementation: Each uploading file exposes role=progressbar with a name
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep progress keyed by file name

guidelines: State accepted types and size limits
goodExamples: PDF or CSV, up to 10 MB
